text:
norah: Quick kickoff for a compact migration checklist we can link in SDK CHANGELOGs and support replies. Must cover: param rename (model_id -> model), embed dim mismatch troubleshooting, streaming callback change, and where we keep legacy snippets. Target: very short, actionable bullets.

yusuf: I'll draft JS + streaming before/after. Will show minimal diffs, include shim toggle example: `new RedwoodClient({ featureFlags: ['docs.v1_compat_shim'] })`.

celia: I’ll do Python + the embed-dim triage flow. Proposed triage: 1) verify expected_dim, 2) try compat model id, 3) escalate with vector sample.

docs-bot: Reminder: add label `docs/compat` and `preview/ready` so preview deploy runs. Editorial freeze kicks in 48h before the deprecation email.

eng-qa: Can we add a single test case asserting embed length in examples? I can add a tiny CI check to examples repo to catch regressions.

rachel: I'll add a one-line "performance note" for mobile: higher-dim embeddings may add ~100ms; suggest prewarm on app start.

sdk-eng: Important: the compatibility shim only renames params. It will NOT reproject embeddings or change sampling semantics. Add that as a caution bullet.

yusuf: Draft streaming snippet for one-pager: 
// v1
client.stream({ model_id: 'rwd-chat-old', onData: (chunk) => ... })
// v2
client.stream({ model: 'rwd-chat-new', onEvent: ({ event, chunk }) => ... })
Will include a tiny migration diff.

celia: Python embed fallback snippet for checklist: 
vec = embeds.create(model='rwd-embed-v2', input=text)
if len(vec) != expected_dim:
    vec = embeds.create(model='rwd-embed-compat', input=text)

eng-qa: I'll add smoke runs on preview; flag any failing snippet as `impact/high`.

norah: Owners: yusuf (js/streaming), celia (py/embed), rachel (mobile note), eng-qa (smoke), sdk-eng (changelog note). Please open PRs today and tag `docs/compat`.

docs-bot: Automation: when PRs are labeled `preview/ready`, the preview URL will post in the PR.

(10m)

eng-qa: Preview builds green for docs PR 8132 and snippets PR 452. Smoke: JS streaming snippet failing due to callback shape; marked `impact/high`. Embed checks pass.

yusuf: Pushed a small snippet fix to match `{ event, chunk }` shape. Re-ran preview, smoke now green.

norah: Great. Celia, please link the one-pager from SDK changelogs and support canned responses. I'll coordinate the deprecation email schedule once merges are complete.

infra: Note: redirects added to `/static/redirects/v1-to-v2-quick.json` in PR 8132. Use 301s for known endpoints.

norah: Thanks team — closing this thread. Final action: QA to post smoke results in each PR before merge. :white_check_mark:
